claim: Re-run the G3 target-blind RAR-residual learner with one fixed shrinkage after nested selection proved unstable. This is an explicitly post-diagnostic exploration reproduction, not independent confirmation.

whole_galaxy_cross_validation.assignment: unchanged balanced name-hash folds from G3-v1

formula_projection.library: G2 structural classes having at least one member galaxy in the outer-training partition
formula_projection.fit_target: the fixed-shrinkage learned V_meta^2 prediction on heldout baryonic radii, never V_obs
formula_projection.coefficients: unweighted two-column least squares to the learned prediction
formula_projection.selection: minimum normalized squared projection error, ties by class ID
formula_projection.evaluation: the projected G2 formula and generated coefficients

decision.pass: the projected training-only G2 formulas beat every baseline by at least 0.5% with zero leakage and all predictions valid
decision.after_pass: authorize G4 construction but retain the post-diagnostic disclosure; do not open confirmation until a compact zero-local-constant law is frozen
decision.after_block: retain counterexamples and keep G4 locked
